query:
SELECT properties.$pathname AS pathname, count() AS views
FROM events
WHERE event = '$pageview'
  AND properties.$host = 'il-biz-tools.netlify.app'
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-05 00:00:00', 'UTC')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-12 00:00:00', 'UTC')
GROUP BY pathname
ORDER BY pathname
LIMIT 1000
hogql: SELECT properties.$pathname AS pathname, count() AS views FROM events WHERE and(equals(event, '$pageview'), equals(properties.$host, 'il-biz-tools.netlify.app'), greaterOrEquals(timestamp, toDateTime('2026-10-05 00:00:00', 'UTC')), less(timestamp, toDateTime('2026-10-12 00:00:00', 'UTC'))) GROUP BY pathname ORDER BY pathname ASC LIMIT 1000
